notes: TEST DRIVE (scene 47, 0x097192) from the hangar menu: the ridden robot (save + 0x60c8) in a battle of mode 6 on contest record 47 (tables/town.json contests, the Scoobee test run), back to the hangar (0x0a8e1b, scene 14) after. The port runs it on the training ground's FreePlay (world/training.json) with that robot as the player's; the contest's own teams wait for the battle roster. Each fitted weapon starts from the training weapon named for its kind here, then takes its record's stats: its reach, lock range and stagger too (port/src/weapon_reach.cpp); the template keeps only a lobbed round's gravity.
